item.title: Overcome Experience Bias 🚀 • Highlight relevant skills in your resume. • Use: “I led a project improving efficiency by 30%.” • Focus on results and impact, not just duties. • Tailor your resume to each job description. • Showcase continuous learning and certifications. 🎓 How can you emphasize your skills over years when applying for roles? #resume #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
